verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Orama to which a user can delegate tasks. AnswerSession is a developer building block for adding ChatGPT-like Q&A to the developer's own website. The MCP server lets external assistants (ChatGPT, Cursor) query project data. The JS runtime is described as a way 'to build agents', which is again a primitive. None of these is an in-product assistant that performs tasks for the user.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
